title: Sync to xDrip : the menu option could be more explicit
body:
If I select _sync to xDrip_ option
![Screenshot_20230708_064226_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/76626474/8c18402d-35b1-4573-88d8-2da9d37892fa)

on the xDrip tab menu
![Screenshot_20230708_064407_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/76626474/c9d42bba-f0fb-4a0a-8874-e2be9381b6a2)

I have a _Full synch_ option
![Screenshot_20230708_064425_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/76626474/75b3f02f-798a-443a-a6c0-b1c438ab640f)

But that option is not for xDrip but for NS
![Screenshot_20230708_064436_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/76626474/9f871717-2b13-44d4-af93-4e94813843bc)

Maybe the menu option could be modified to indicate _Full **NS** synchronisation_
